reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

I checked first that he's a member of that channel, then read its history. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

The channel has no address or other site details for Southgate, and I found no Tansley account files in the shared files. I said so in the reply and suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs the full address.
